criteria.description: Breaks the feature into screens and their component parts, rather than describing one undifferentiated UI.
Specifies the full set of UI states (empty, loading, error, success, and edge cases) for the screens — not just the happy/success path.
Defines the data entities/fields the UI binds to, ideally with sample data, rather than leaving the tool to improvise.
Specifies interactions and flow — what each action does and where it leads.
Includes acceptance criteria so the generated prototype can be checked (covering states/interactions), enabling precise re-prompting.
Scopes to a demonstrable flow and is written as a concrete, paste-ready brief rather than vague prose.
